spec.scene: A patch of dark wet asphalt glistening with reflective puddles fills the ground. At the center sits a compact dark blue car with wet glossy panels, its cozy interior glowing with warm golden cabin light. Through the clear front window, a small figure in a damp gray hooded jacket sits holding a plastic tray piled high with golden nachos covered in bright orange melted cheese. At the back right edge stands a tall metal light pole casting a warm amber glow over the rain-slicked surface.
spec.title: Gas Station Nachos
spec.caption: Eating gas station nachos in my car like a raccoon.
